column1: # Package groups: bucket<TAB>regex, matched against the whole source package
# name.  Every pool file goes to exactly one bucket, so the buckets add up to
# the archive: "kernel" comes first and is the kernel rule, not a pattern;
# then these, in order, the first match winning; then "other" for the rest.
# Matched on the source rather than the binary, so a library a driver ships
# goes with the driver.  The patterns name sources outright where a prefix
# would sweep in strangers -- ^roc would take rocksdb and rockdodger, ^libcu
# The page draws these in this order.  The aggregator is handed this file's
# contents and the cache key covers them, so an edit here re-aggregates on
# the next build without anyone having to bump AGGREGATE_VERSION.
